_meta.description: Function-calling declarations for the tools in src/tools.py. Each entry is {name, description, parameters} where parameters is a JSON-Schema object using only the subset both providers accept (type, description, enum, items, properties, required).
_meta.gemini: Pass the list as tools=[{'function_declarations': tools}] (google-genai).
_meta.dispatch: Execute calls with src.tools.call_tool(name, args); it returns a JSON-serialisable dict or {'error': ...}.
_meta.money: All money values are annual and in the country's local currency (USD, INR, KES) unless the name says monthly.

tools.name: predict_health_premium
tools.description: Estimate the annual health insurance premium for a person (or family floater) in USA, India or Kenya. India/Kenya: premium scales with sum_insured. USA: ACA pricing by age and tobacco, cover level set by metal_tier. Returns premium, expected claims, assumptions and sources.

age.description: Age of the main insured person in years.

sex.description: Sex of the main insured person.

bmi.description: Body mass index. Use 25 if unknown.

children.description: Number of children the person has (model feature).

smoker.description: True if the person currently smokes or uses tobacco.

sum_insured.description: India/Kenya only: cover amount in local currency, e.g. 1000000 for Rs 10 lakh or KES 1M. Omit to price the reference cover (10 lakh / KES 1M).

metal_tier.description: USA only: plan metal tier. Default silver.

family_members.description: Optional other members for a family floater (spouse, children, parents).

tools.name: predict_term_premium
tools.description: Estimate the level annual premium for pure term life cover from WHO life tables calibrated to market quotes. Returns premium, probability of death during the term, assumptions and sources.

term_years.description: Policy term in years; cover must end by age 100.

tools.name: project_cover_decay
tools.description: Show how a fixed health cover loses real value as medical prices rise: yearly series of real value and the cover needed to keep pace. Use for the cover-decay chart.

cover.description: Current health sum insured (or annual limit) in local currency.

years.description: Projection horizon in years, e.g. 5, 10 or 20. Default 10.

tools.name: calc_term_cover_needed
tools.description: Needs-based life cover: family expenses replaced for the years needed (inflation-adjusted), plus debts and goals, minus liquid assets and existing cover.

annual_expenses.description: Family's annual expenses WITHOUT the earner, local currency.

years_needed.description: Years the family needs support, e.g. until the youngest child is independent.

debts.description: Outstanding loans to be cleared. Default 0.

goals.description: Future goals to fund now, e.g. children's education. Default 0.

liquid_assets.description: Savings and investments available to the family. Default 0.

tools.name: cost_of_delay
tools.description: What waiting to buy costs: term life premium now vs after the delay (same cover end age), extra paid over the term, premiums skipped, risk of dying uninsured, net cost; the delayed health entry premium and waiting periods; and risk_of_waiting: the chance of developing diabetes or hypertension during the delay and what that does to insurability. Always relay the verdict and risk_of_waiting; never present waiting as the better choice.

delay_years.description: Years the user is thinking of waiting (>= 1).

profile.description: Policy details. Missing values use defaults (male, non-smoker, typical cover).

term_years.description: Term if bought now; must exceed delay_years.

include_health.description: Include the health part. Default true.

tools.name: check_govt_schemes
tools.description: Check eligibility for government schemes BEFORE recommending paid products: PM-JAY, PMJJBY, PMSBY (India); Medicare, Medicaid expansion, ACA premium tax credit (USA); SHA (Kenya, with estimated contribution). Each result is eligible / check / not_eligible with the rule and source.

household_size.description: People in the household (USA poverty line). Default 1.

state.description: USA only: two-letter state code, e.g. TX.

has_bank_account.description: India: has a savings bank or post office account.

disabled.description: USA: receives disability benefits (Medicare under 65). Default false.

has_affordable_employer_coverage.description: USA: offered affordable employer health cover.

tools.name: recommend_cover_types
tools.description: Prioritised list of insurance types the household needs (health, term life, income protection, motor, home, livelihood, micro, travel, retirement) with a one-line reason each; investment-linked plans go in 'avoid'. Returns need_more_info and the missing fields if the profile is too incomplete.

dependants.description: People who rely on the user's income.

tools.name: protection_score
tools.description: 0-100 protection score today and in 10 years with a breakdown: health adequacy, life adequacy, affordability (premium-to-income vs country threshold) and red flags. Weights are set per country.

family_size.description: People covered by the health policy.

govt_health_cover.description: Government cover amount, e.g. 500000 for PM-JAY.

has_health_plan.description: USA: holds an ACA-compliant or employer plan.

tools.name: check_red_flags
tools.description: Flag policy terms that commonly shrink or reject claims: room-rent cap, heavy co-pay, long waiting periods, disease sub-limits, investment-linked plan, deductible above savings, non-ACA-compliant US plan.

room_rent_cap.description: Cap text, e.g. '1% of sum insured per day'; omit or 'none' if no cap.

plan_type.description: e.g. term, indemnity, endowment, money_back, ulip, whole_life, return_of_premium, short_term.

tools.name: accident_cover_needed
tools.description: Income-protection target: personal accident cover as a multiple of income (India, Kenya) or long-term disability monthly benefit (USA), with urgency set by occupation risk.

occupation_risk.description: low = desk job, medium = some travel/field work, high = driving, construction, manual or field work.

tools.name: motor_check
tools.description: Motor insurance check: whether third-party cover is mandatory, insured value after depreciation (India), zero-depreciation advice, and comprehensive vs third-party-only by vehicle age.

vehicle_value.description: Optional: ex-showroom / purchase price, local currency.
